hero.title: Privacy Notice
hero.description: PRIVACY NOTICE OF "ANAEROBIA" S.A. DE C.V.

contenido.content:
In accordance with Mexico's Federal Law on the Protection of Personal Data Held by Private Parties (the "Law"), we make available this PRIVACY NOTICE under the following terms:

Party responsible for the use and protection of personal data

The handling of your personal data is of vital importance to us. ANAEROBIA S.A. DE C.V., hereinafter "ANAEROBIA", with address at Paseo Sinfonía, número 5, Plaza Jazz, interior L-3-14, Lomas de Angelópolis II, San Andrés Cholula, Puebla, C.P. 72830, and as the party responsible for the processing of your personal data, informs you that our clients' information is handled in strict confidence. By providing personal data such as:

  • Full name.
  • Corporate formation documents.
  • Legal representatives.
  • Address.
  • Office and mobile phone numbers.
  • Email addresses.
  • Bank account details.
  • Government institution data.

Such data will be kept confidential in accordance with the Law.

Security and confidentiality measures for information

"ANAEROBIA" commits to implementing the physical, administrative, and technical security measures necessary to protect your personal information against damage, loss, alteration, destruction, or unauthorized use, access, or processing.

Likewise, "ANAEROBIA" and its employees responsible for handling your data in the course of their duties, or who take part in any phase of its processing, commit to keeping your personal information confidential, even after your relationship with us has ended.

Purposes of data processing

The personal data collected by "ANAEROBIA" is used to:

  • Prepare documents (contracts, agreements, purchase orders, etc.).
  • Follow up on the business relationship.
  • Update our database.

Use, disclosure, and A.R.C.O. rights

All personal data is handled under confidentiality standards. As the data subject, you have the right to: Access, Rectify, Cancel, or Object to the processing we give it (A.R.C.O. rights). You may exercise these rights verbally when this notice is provided to you, or later by email at eticaempresarial@anaerobia.com.mx

Once your request to exercise A.R.C.O. rights is received through the means mentioned above, you will receive a response within no more than 20 business days. After receiving that response, you will have 15 business days to reply; if you do not respond to "ANAEROBIA"'s reply within that period, it will be understood in good faith that you agree with the response.

Data transfer

We inform you that all contracts, agreements, or other documents with third parties that involve the processing of your confidential information on behalf of "ANAEROBIA" will include a clause guaranteeing that they provide the level of data protection referred to in the Law, and we commit to ensuring compliance with the principles set out in these personal data protection guidelines, affirming our commitment to upholding this privacy notice at all times.

"ANAEROBIA" may transfer your personal data to its external consultants in the event of any legal dispute arising from the services provided or the business relationship you have with "ANAEROBIA" or its affiliates.

Changes to the privacy notice

This Privacy Notice may be modified by "ANAEROBIA" at any time; any such changes will be communicated to users who have already provided their information, via the email address they provided to us.
